author: prabal04das
content: <@257827563882151937> Is Myotis light client Stateful(i.e. stores last state before going offline) or Stateless?

author: dirkjaeckel
content:
It stores several things. 1. A cache of peers that were helpful the last time
2. Sync committee: light client bootstrap and light client updates
3. Optional: logindex data for certain contracts

 That's it from the top of my head. There might be more.

It is definitely not stateless.

Does that answer your question?
